summary.text: MOEN MARIN AS (912 082 679), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2013-06-03; address Marøystrandvegen 36, 7900 RØRVIK, Norge. Main industry is Building of civilian ships and floating structures (30.110); 65 registered employees; 2 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Lars Ivar Viken Elvertrø; Board chair: Audun Sivertsen Fjeldvær; Auditor: PRICEWATERHOUSECOOPERS AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 1.21 bn, operating profit NOK 62.86 m, net profit NOK 38.91 m, equity NOK 238.06 m, total assets NOK 1.26 bn. Official website https://www.moenmarin.no is verified (the registry lists it and the site shows the registered name); company-owned profiles on facebook, instagram, linkedin, youtube.
